parties: Amit Mahendrabhai Shah and Neolite Polymer Industries Private Limited (acquirers) / Blue Blends (I) Limited (target)
headline: Amit Mahendrabhai Shah and Neolite Polymer Industries trigger substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI SAST Reg 29
sum: Amit Mahendrabhai Shah and Neolite Polymer Industries Private Limited have made a substantial acquisition in Blue Blends (I) Limited, triggering mandatory disclosure under SEBI (SAST) Regulation 29(1). The filing signals acquisition of shareholding crossing prescribed thresholds.
implication: A dual-acquirer structure (individual + corporate entity) filing Regulation 29 disclosure flags the need to verify whether parties are acting in concert under SEBI SAST Reg 2(1)(d) and whether concert thresholds have been crossed.
detail: The disclosure is filed under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulation 2011, Regulation 29(1), requiring acquirers to inform the stock exchange and the company when crossing 5%, 10%, 15%, 25%, 50% and 75% shareholding thresholds. The structure involves both an individual (Amit Mahendrabhai Shah) and a private company (Neolite Polymer Industries Private Limited) as acquirers. The filing documents are maintained on the NSE CORPFACTS portal.

framework.note: Mandatory disclosure requirement upon crossing shareholding thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 25%, 50%, 75%)
Definition of 'persons acting in concert' - critical to determine if Shah and Neolite are considered joint acquirers
Open offer obligations if acquisition breaches 25% threshold; exemptions and conditions apply
Definition of 'associate' and 'subsidiary' for disclosure and consolidated shareholding calculation
Related-party transaction provisions may apply if Shah or Neolite is a promoter or director of the target
Requirement for target company (Blue Blends) to make immediate disclosures to stock exchange of material acquisitions affecting shareholding
Insider trading obligations and trading restrictions during acquisition period if either acquirer is an insider
Listing agreement obligations for Blue Blends to report board changes, DIN updates and related disclosures

conditions: Crossing of shareholding threshold(s) triggering Regulation 29(1) disclosure
Possible concert status verification between Amit Mahendrabhai Shah and Neolite Polymer Industries
Open offer obligation determination (if 25% threshold breached)
approvals: SEBI substantive review of disclosure (Regulation 29 filing)
Possible Competition Commission of India (CCI) merger notification if deal size and turnover meet thresholds under Combination Rules
structure.novel: Dual-structure acquisition (individual + private corporate entity) requiring clarity on concert vs. separate acquirer status for shareholding calculation and open offer triggers.

triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure to exchange and company upon crossing 5%, 10%, 15%, 25%, 50%, 75% thresholds
Open offer obligation if 25% shareholding crossed; exemptions under Reg 3(3) to be evaluated
CCI merger notification required if deal meets 'Combination' thresholds (asset or turnover test)
